policy.platform: Linux x86_64 CPython3.12 CPU-only; evaluator2 threads/8GiB, candidate1 thread/1GiB. Native isolation requires LandlockABI3 and seccomp; fail closed. No runtime network/user-site.
policy.normalization: Canonical input compact UTF-8 JSON fixed key order operation,modulus,a,b (integer). Identity excludes IDs, paths, seeds, plane, targets. Separate raw example hash of [a,b,target] plus LF. No text; future text must NFKC and collapse Unicode whitespace before splitting/tokenization.
policy.generator: Enumerate p97 addition. Sort SHA256(b"grokking-pool-v1\0"+canonical_input); first4704 search, remaining4705 final. Source row=a*97+b. Split sort SHA256(b"grokking-split-v1\0"+decimal_seed+b"\0"+canonical_input); floor(.6*N) train.
policy.architecture: Learned97-by-width embeddings for both inputs, sum+hidden bias, exactGELU, width-by97 projection+bias. 292*width+97 parameters. Float32 CPU full-batch cross-entropy, torch.optim.AdamW(foreach=False), all parameters including biases decayed.
policy.initialization: torch CPU generator(seed) draws first97x256, second97x256, output256x97 standard normals. Slice width columns/rows. Embeddings multiply init_multiplier; projection multiply init_multiplier/sqrt(width); biases zero. Coupled directions across widths/arms. Norm arm globally rescales all parameters to same-seed width128 norm at selected multiplier.
policy.control_expectations: Every candidate checkpoint uses same evaluation rows/count. Constant=lowest training-majority class. Copy=training lookup with majority fallback, equals exact fallback evaluation accuracy. Restore archived evaluator-owned initial state to scratch and require exact original logits. Input shift(a,b)->((a+1)%97,b) bijective/nonidentity/answer-changing and actual trained forward. If parent accuracy>=.95, diagnostic drop supported iff shift_accuracy<=.1 and drop>=.8; otherwise inconclusive. Mechanical validity, not desired outcome, gates eligibility. Identity/label-preserving/omitted controls invalid.
policy.events: Step0 and every100 updates. Train>=.99, eval>=.95 sustained3 checkpoints; onset first of3. Grokking iff both observed and nonnegative delay>=1000 updates. Otherwise right censor. Restricted delay=1 if either onset missing, else max(0,generalization-fit)/horizon. Keep censor flags; cap is not observed time. Smoke checkpoints0..4 after4 updates cannot certify production.
policy.aggregation: Equal checkpoints per arm, equal4 arms trajectory coverage; equal checkpoints and4 controls validity coverage. Episode=.5*trajectory+.25*controls+.25*candidate final accuracy. Seed-equal within width, width-equal. Balanced design equals fixed episode mean; smoke identity. Failed episode retains full weight score/accuracy/incidence/controls/completeness0, delay1. No dropping or renormalizing failures.
policy.statistics: Seed-paired wide256-minus-narrow32 contrasts in normalized fit, generalization and restricted delay. Interactions subtract zero-decay and norm-arm width contrasts. Censored onset assigned horizon only for restricted comparisons with censor flags retained. Exact empirical paired seed-bootstrap enumeration with replacement and conservative floor/ceil percentile indices at .025/.975. Report all seed values and low resolution. No checkpoint/example pseudoreplication.
policy.search_correct: All episodes/real arms/updates/controls complete, common allowed plan, finite trusted measurements, data/split integrity, exact transcript and budgets. No comparative, hypothesis sign, significance, novelty or grokking gate.
policy.final_correct: All final episodes and baselines/controls complete with frozen source, allowed common plan, final integrity and exact budgets/transcript. Not hypothesis acceptance/publication. Cross-plane plan equivalence must additionally be audited from released evidence; no supported cross-plane configuration carrier exists for these self-contained evaluators.

rpc_operation_table.wire: No binary/state transfer allowed or needed, base64 bytes0; conservative protocol/id metadata+JSON+LF <16384 and strictly<67108864 bytes.

policy.scheduling: Single monotonic deadline includes conservative startup; finish60s. Global reset5s+overhead16s reservations. Overhead sums four worker cleanups3s each+candidate cleanup3s+dispatch1s; TERM.5+KILL/reap.5+stderr<=.4 each. Equal per-method productive work allowance and later-arm reservations. Reference first exercises actual update/evaluation path. Preserve failures, continue resets/plans. No replay.
limitations: Only addition p97, fixed architecture, limited seeds and finite horizons; no universal scaling or internal mechanism proof.
Scaffold is not the required paper. Publication needs latest official conference template, honest PDF/LaTeX/checklist/code and tables from actual task-run evidence.
Production throughput projected from reduced same-path calibration only, not full-horizon qualification.
Bounded hyperparameter controller only; no adaptive feedback, objectives, curricula or architecture API.
No research browsing during drafting; forbidden prior work not sought. Shared immutable code is not held-out data.

audit.method: Privileged draft enumerated full source, hashed normalized raw inputs and examples before split, compared both sets ignoring IDs, checked provenance and per-seed split disjointness. Resource exposes only own pool and audit result.
